title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Please don’t tell me those guys got fired because of sales
Heard Steve Fox and Scot Pett were let go
Yes they were but I wasn’t given a reason
Pett has been there forever wow
Mr I was fond of Scot
Lemme know if you hear anything else. Not sure what to do with it but optics aren’t great, given the crap product
Was there an e-mail sent out to the ticket staff or anything about their departures
I’m in KC- are you here?
Oh nice. Yeah driving to the park now
Oh ok- I’m by the pool at Intercontinental- the 5 of us in suites/premium are all here and just got a call on it this morning. We took clients on a trip so we missed all the action back home
Enjoy... you coming to the game?
Ok, hit me up when you’re there or maybe we could grab a drink after. I’m nearby in the plaza
